rules.sentence: When `LK-PRODUCT` is `'GD'` (`LK-GOLD`) and `LK-OVER-AMOUNT` is at most `GOLD-ALLOWANCE`, it sets `LK-FEE` to zero and returns to its caller.

When `LK-PRODUCT` is not `'GD'` (not `LK-GOLD`) or `LK-OVER-AMOUNT` is more than `GOLD-ALLOWANCE`; and `LK-FEE` is less than `LEAST-FEE`, it computes `LK-FEE` as `LK-OVER-AMOUNT / 10`, sets `LK-FEE` to `LEAST-FEE`, and returns to its caller.

When `LK-PRODUCT` is not `'GD'` (not `LK-GOLD`) or `LK-OVER-AMOUNT` is more than `GOLD-ALLOWANCE`; `LK-FEE` is at least `LEAST-FEE`; and `LK-FEE` is more than `MOST-FEE`, it computes `LK-FEE` as `LK-OVER-AMOUNT / 10`, sets `LK-FEE` to `MOST-FEE`, and returns to its caller.

When `LK-PRODUCT` is not `'GD'` (not `LK-GOLD`) or `LK-OVER-AMOUNT` is more than `GOLD-ALLOWANCE`; `LK-FEE` is at least `LEAST-FEE`; and `LK-FEE` is at most `MOST-FEE`, it computes `LK-FEE` as `LK-OVER-AMOUNT / 10` and returns to its caller.
